First, we speak to The Indian Express’ Rural Affairs and Agriculture Editor Harish Damodaran about India’s emerging milk-fat shortage, why ghee and butter prices are rising, and whether consumers could face further increases.
Next, we speak to The Indian Express’ Amitabh Sinha about COP31 in Turkey, the growing gap between global climate commitments and action, and why the Paris Agreement’s 1.5-degree target is slipping out of reach. (08:40)
